notes: Positive: prompts asking to review, audit, evaluate, or assess existing code or a PR; identify tech debt; flag dependency hygiene; scrutinize AI-generated code. Negative: requests to write net-new features, design tests strategy, do threat modeling, plan architecture, or edit meta-component files. Edge: refactor requests that include 'review then change' phrasing, or audits that may overlap with quality / security.
